epic.title: Organization Quotas and User Management
epic.functionalNeed: Organization management is too rigid to scale. Organizations have no enforced usage quota, and only internal operators can add users, so every new team member has to go through the operations team even when the organization has room to grow. This EPIC adds an enforced per-organization user quota set in the back office, and lets editor users add users to their own organization as long as they stay within that quota, without waiting on the operations team.
scope: Per-organization user quota set and managed in the back office
Editor users can add users to their own organization within quota
Reader users can view organization members in read-only
Super admin users excluded from quota count and hidden from front office
Rollout default quota of 100 for existing organizations
Invited-but-not-yet-active users count against the quota
Suspended users keep their seat; only soft-delete frees a seat
outOfScope: Internal operations monitoring and cost dashboards (covered by EPIC-028)
Multi-organization membership and organization selection at sign-in (covered by EPIC-030 / GEO-681)
Role definitions beyond what is needed for editors to add users and readers to be excluded
Resend invitation (out of scope V1 — backoffice-only)
stillOpen: Confirm whether the user quota counts invited-but-not-yet-active users against the limit (resolved: yes, they count)
Confirm whether editors can also resend invitations or remove users they added (resolved: resend = out of scope V1)

stories.title: Per-organization user quota in the back office

userStory.want: to set a user quota on each organization
userStory.so: that the number of users an organization can have is controlled centrally

acceptanceCriteria.title: Set or change the quota
acceptanceCriteria.given: an operator opens an organization in the back office
acceptanceCriteria.when: they set or change its user quota
acceptanceCriteria.then: the quota is saved and shown on the organization

acceptanceCriteria.title: Current count shown against the quota
acceptanceCriteria.given: an organization with a set quota
acceptanceCriteria.then: the current user count is shown against the quota

acceptanceCriteria.title: Lowering below current count warns but does not remove
acceptanceCriteria.given: an operator lowers a quota below the current user count
acceptanceCriteria.then: the change is not blocked, they are warned, and existing users are not removed automatically

acceptanceCriteria.title: Over-quota organizations block all adds
acceptanceCriteria.given: an organization whose user count is above its quota
acceptanceCriteria.when: anyone tries to add a user to it
acceptanceCriteria.then: adding users is blocked for as long as the organization remains above quota

acceptanceCriteria.title: Super admins are not counted
acceptanceCriteria.given: an organization with super admin users
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user count is compared against the quota
acceptanceCriteria.then: super admin users are not counted toward the quota

acceptanceCriteria.title: Rollout default of 100
acceptanceCriteria.then: every organization receives a default quota of 100, and an internal operator then manually adjusts each organization's quota to its real entitlement

technicalNotes: Invited-but-not-yet-active users count against the quota
Suspended users keep counting; only soft-delete frees a seat

stories.title: Editors add users within their organization quota

userStory.want: to add users to my own organization
userStory.so: my team can be onboarded without waiting on the operations team, as long as we stay within our quota

acceptanceCriteria.title: Add under quota
acceptanceCriteria.given: an editor in an organization that is below its user quota
acceptanceCriteria.then: the user is created in that organization and receives the standard welcome invitation

acceptanceCriteria.title: Blocked when quota full
acceptanceCriteria.given: an editor in an organization that has reached or exceeded its user quota
acceptanceCriteria.when: they try to add a user
acceptanceCriteria.then: the action is blocked and a clear message explains the quota is full

acceptanceCriteria.title: Own organization only
acceptanceCriteria.then: they can only add users to the organization they are currently in and where they hold the editor role, never to another organization

acceptanceCriteria.title: Super admins hidden from front office
acceptanceCriteria.given: a front office user (editor or reader)
acceptanceCriteria.then: super admin users do not appear in the user list

acceptanceCriteria.title: Editor changes a user's role
acceptanceCriteria.given: an editor viewing the user list
acceptanceCriteria.when: they open a user's row actions and change the role (Reader ↔ Editor)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the new role is saved and reflected in the list immediately

acceptanceCriteria.title: Editor suspends and reactivates a user
acceptanceCriteria.given: an editor viewing an active user
acceptanceCriteria.then: the user can no longer sign in, appears with status suspended, and still occupies a seat; and when reactivated, regains access with the same role as before

acceptanceCriteria.title: Editor soft-deletes a user
acceptanceCriteria.given: an editor viewing a user of their organization
acceptanceCriteria.then: the user loses access, no longer appears as active, and their seat is freed in the quota count

technicalNotes: Resend invitation: out of scope V1 (stays backoffice-only)
Guard rails: editor cannot act on themselves or on ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN users; assignable roles limited to Reader/Editor
Duplicate email: editor may learn the account already exists in another organization
'All statuses' filter includes soft-deleted users; deleted rows expose no row actions
ACs 6-8 confirmed in scope by PM (comment 826032, 2026-08-03)

stories.title: Readers view organization users in read-only

userStory.want: to see the user settings of my organization
userStory.so: I know who is part of my organization and who holds the editor role

acceptanceCriteria.title: Reader sees the list with roles
acceptanceCriteria.then: they see the list of users in their organization with each user's role (editor or reader)

acceptanceCriteria.title: No management actions
acceptanceCriteria.given: a reader user viewing the user settings
acceptanceCriteria.then: no actions to create users, delete users, or change a user's role are available to them

acceptanceCriteria.title: Own organization only
acceptanceCriteria.then: they only see users belonging to their own organization

technicalNotes: Blue info banner: 'You have view-only access. Contact an editor in your organisation to manage users.'
Seats bar kept with caption 'Managed by your organisation's editors'
No Provision button, no ACTIONS column; same search/filters/pagination as editor view
